events.text: TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Kawuwema bars the shaft to Dadomonone, and the data-tithe-collectors of Sewchaw are turned back at the lamps of Hongeha.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Lersuf close the air-lanes above Fememanui, starving Warovene of the high trade.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Bruglu give way! Vanguard forces of Lyyghyeh storm the royal seat of Bruglu, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: Kingdom of Lerwyt is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Midliha Tesvhetlih flees into obscurity.
U-mponfu Beyond's invasion through the Burning Veil into Shode was repulsed at Mwange.
Canoe Launching: People of Warovene wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Ngatavika.

The final citadels fall, and the board of Chiefdom of Bruglu is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Blaqli Brinlius flees into bitter exile as the corp-state fades into legend.
The Hundred Days War of Bruglu reaches its conclusion after less than a year of bloodshed: Lyyghyeh triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Lopa II of Pusiba takes up the cause of the safety of the corp-state.
Mourning envelops Pusiba: Lopa the Younger Manonumase dies of a wasting sickness. The royal scepter passes to Lopa, an underage youth of 1 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Sewchaw! Dabi seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Sewchaw!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Yusu strike at midnight in Sofeba! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Sofeba!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Wemanui! Fapara seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Military Junta of Wemanui!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Bitsabia stir mutiny among garrison troops in Âthkêm!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Tofo divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Lersuf!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Tofo are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Lersuf!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Counterfeit letters planted by Vugvassuvriq rupture trust between Ru'urhyth and their ally Ru'urloth!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Vugvassuvriq are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Ru'urhyth!

Fofe of Hongeha takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.
The death of Kinge Newo (a fall from a horse) leaves Hongeha without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Nano seizes the high boardroom amidst palace turmoil.
Fafona of Hongeha turns from the old cause toward wealth.
A perilous interregnum grips Hongeha following the heirless death of Fofe (old age). Retainers of House Hifewomu storm the assembly and usurp the board.

MERCANTILE SECESSION: Wealthy patricians and merchant cartels in Ngoruwepeha rebel against royal tariffs! Declaring commercial independence from Hongeha, Refungafa establishes the Commercial Union of Ngoruwepeha.
Refungafa is acclaimed ruler of Commercial Union of Ngoruwepeha.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Trade Federation of Hongeha dispatches punitive legions to subdue Commercial Union of Ngoruwepeha. The bitter Invasion of Ngoruwepeha is underway.
Stock in Hongeha goes vertical: new arcologies rise and the upper tiers party for a year.
The vat farms of Fâmkif catch a blight-code; nutrient prices triple overnight.
In the hungry year Êth spends the treasury of Fâmkif on grain from abroad; few starve, and they remember who fed them.
Ngida (Grand Champion) defeats a formidable foreign corp operative in single combat before the royal court in Hasilethani.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: Abyssal Terror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Auspicious Horned Beast
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Tusk-Lord of the Briars
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Primeval Behemoth
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The All-Knowing Simurgh
monsters.lore: A vast and wise bird that has seen the world destroyed three times; it may help a hero or test them.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: Smokeless-Fire Ifrit
monsters.lore: A spirit of smokeless fire, proud and cunning, bound by old seals and older bargains.

monsters.name: Hand-Tailed Ahuizotl
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

wonders.lore: Erected in the mythic ages of Mangrar, Adamantine Foundry of the Deep remains one of the supreme wonders of the mortal world.
wonders.effect: +20 Army Power and periodically bestows legendary weapons upon the realm.

wonders.name: Ruins of Atlantis
wonders.lore: Erected in the mythic ages of Mangrar, Ruins of Atlantis remains one of the supreme wonders of the mortal world.
wonders.effect: +20 Intrigue and reveals sunken treasures of antiquity.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

events.text: Insurrection flares in Ki-nya! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Tisebọ and rallies beneath the banner of Mbunpanba, establishing the Cybernetic Union of Ki-nya.
Mbunpanba is acclaimed ruler of Cybernetic Union of Ki-nya.

Outraged by treason, the board of Popular Commonwealth of Tisebọ mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Cybernetic Union of Ki-nya. The Tisebọ–Ki-nya War begins in fire and iron.

MERCANTILE SECESSION: Wealthy patricians and merchant cartels in Ix-nasuta rebel against royal tariffs! Declaring commercial independence from Likofọba, Name establishes the Trade Federation of Ix-nasuta.
Name is acclaimed ruler of Trade Federation of Ix-nasuta.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Empire of Likofọba dispatches punitive legions to subdue Trade Federation of Ix-nasuta. The bitter War of the Ix-nasuta Crown is underway.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Tungi take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Nukahuhuasi, they hoist republican banners beneath Kote to establish the Free Commonwealth of Nungo.
Kote is acclaimed ruler of Free Commonwealth of Nungo.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Empire of Nukahuhuasi dispatches punitive legions to subdue Free Commonwealth of Nungo. The bitter Invasion of Nungo is underway.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal data-tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Pohlih rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Yohtlopih, they establish the Popular Commonwealth of Pohlih with Kewihmoh leading the commune.
Kewihmoh is acclaimed ruler of Popular Commonwealth of Pohlih.

Outraged by treason, the board of Free Trading Cities of Yohtlopih mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Popular Commonwealth of Pohlih. The Great Yohtlopih War begins in fire and iron.

Ballgame Festival: Warriors of Kohke parade and wrestle in the squares of Kohke to honour the old victories.

With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Polytechnic League of Quthaq marches against Artificer Directorate of Lavizamin. The Hundred Days War of Lavizamin begins. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of U-dome rally to Lavizamin's side.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The Wale Campaign ends in mutual exhaustion after 4 years; borders return to former lines.
Through stubborn resolve, Bojupe'enowu & Nehmohtitlan shatter the enemy offensive. The Great Chasenokana War ends after 1 year with the defenders holding firm.
Puha of Lavizamin takes up the cause of glory.
In Lavizamin, Voka the Brave Viva departs this life, succumbing to old age. The child Puha (age 10) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Phutza of Mbeska turns from the old cause toward wealth.
The death of Szalba Mbynchy (old age) leaves Mbeska without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Rzeztaslhlpcha seizes the high boardroom amidst palace turmoil.
Master Artisan Papa of Qañicocha achieves worldwide acclaim with their magnum opus: "The Celestial Symphony".

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Spurred by cries for liberty and bread, popular assemblies across Titloh overthrow the old order! Monarchy is dismantled, and the revolutionary convention inaugurates the Republic of Titloh.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Thezlo strike in the dead of night, slaying Jepa in the court of Wale!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Tisebọ detonate powder stores in Lavizamin, gutting frontline regiments!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Bufalia sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Nkenze.
QUEST COMPLETED: Liberation of the Captive Sage in Oyo-yebolo! Mawuwata successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Kohke pave the Yekohuacan-Tlolohtitlan Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Yekohuacan and Tlolohtitlan (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Xehyeghloth pave the Huhqoq-Sopopemume Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Huhqoq and Sopopemume (+trade, +stability).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of U-dome! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Cthulor the Abyssal Slumberer stirs in the ocean abyss beneath Henyin! Barnacle-encrusted cyclopean monoliths surface, loaded with pre-human treasure (+35 gold, -5 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Luxuria the Gilded Prince intoxicates the high courts of Nupetun with exquisite hedonism! Opulence surges alongside reckless decadence (+40 gold, -10 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Ignis the Hearth Caldera stokes the caldera hearths of Telyegh! Master smiths forge shimmering obsidian weaponry bathed in magma (+16% army power, +15 gold).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Cthulor the Abyssal Slumberer stirs in the ocean abyss beneath Bopodufe! Barnacle-encrusted cyclopean monoliths surface, loaded with pre-human treasure (+35 gold, -5 stability).
Street samurai Kesa defends a Pohlih clinic from corp extraction teams; the gangs call a truce in their honour.
Zuhliyxir, a burned-out netrunner, livestreams from Huhqoq that the corps can be logged out of existence; millions tune in.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Hemolavi; bread riots in Yohtitlan (Chasenokana).

The last patron of the Hollow Guild of Mupo turns on it: Thegorod burns its works and silences the masters.
Houses of the Wayfarers of Viracocha of Kuñichi open in Chasenokana.
Chekawa of Tlahyahpah yields to the Society of the Written Code: legal reform becomes the law of the land.
The peace dictated by Bojupe'enowu ends free contractors in Chasenokana; the victors impose mesh collectives.
A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of Wongen around Dinshima; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
A cave-in thunders through Ho'ihr'; Xyoxyth digs for survivors for weeks.
The tiny Free Commonwealth of Helyugh seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Zultal.
Nopulik'in squeezes the shaft-tolls of Zlasme; the miners of Ntyska mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Lertol bars the shaft to Henyunhara, and the data-tithe-collectors of Kanuhupampa are turned back at the lamps of Ghoqyeloth.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Lattok bars the shaft to Henyunhara, and the data-tithe-collectors of Kanuhupampa are turned back at the lamps of Hezzulyeh.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Yalqogh bars the shaft to Hafado, and the data-tithe-collectors of Hani are turned back at the lamps of Hezzulyeh.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Kuwe close the air-lanes above Tisebọ, starving Tisebọ of the high trade.
The Wale Campaign is known as the War of Deliverance in Jubapeka'e, and as the Years of Ash in Wale.
The Great Chasenokana War is known as the Unprovoked War among the Yahatahpa, and as the Rightful War among the Notu.
Festival of the New Count: The longest night in Tachumnal is spent by firelight in Tachumnal, with stories and gifts.

monsters.name: Qilin of the Cloud-Peaks
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Roc the Sky-Render
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: The Radiant Sovereign
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Sky-Blotter
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: Amaru the Winged Serpent
monsters.lore: A two-headed winged serpent of the high lakes, bringer of storms and of the underworld’s waters.

monsters.name: The River-Blocker
monsters.lore: A huge river creature of the deep forest that blocks the flow of rivers with its body.

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

The final citadels fall, and the board of Megacorp of Funlurb is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Dujwsada Rirzbibdsins flees into bitter exile as the corp-state fades into legend.
A victor's peace is forged: after less than a year of campaign in the Great Slonti War, Slonti prevail, annexing contested borderlands.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
